title: Default save path for New+ templates should not be dependent by language setting

judgment.rationale: The code directly confirms a localized default resource, but migration and documentation policy require a deliberate compatibility decision.
evidence: The Japanese reporter observes a localized New+ template directory while documentation shows the literal Templates folder, and requests a stable language-independent path.
The issue is a path and documentation consistency request, not evidence that every Unicode path fails.

The pinned New+ default path uses a localized resource with Templates as fallback: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/settings.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The code directly confirms a localized default resource, but migration and documentation policy require a deliberate compatibility decision.

proposed_fixes.title: Make New+ template location predictable across languages
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A language-independent default could remove documentation ambiguity, but moving existing user templates or overriding a configured location risks data loss or surprising behavior.
plan: Confirm intended default-path policy and reconcile localized documentation with the actual configurable location.
If maintainers choose a stable default, use it for new configurations and design a non-destructive migration that retains existing or explicitly customized paths.
Test fresh and existing Japanese and English profiles, template discovery, custom locations, and language changes.
verification: New users and documentation agree on the default location, while existing templates and user-selected locations remain available.

confidence.rationale: The code directly confirms a localized default resource, but migration and documentation policy require a deliberate compatibility decision.
